botec.title: Open BOTEC estimate record
botec.description: One back-of-the-envelope cost-effectiveness estimate for one (organization, program, intervention archetype, geography, year, model version). Native outcomes are primary. The QALY conversion is a separate, versioned layer that can be absent, disputed, or replaced without touching the native-unit estimate. Every numeric input is a distribution with a cited basis. Draft design, 2026-10-18; not yet used by the GiveBetter site.

id.description: Stable ID derived from the key: <orgId>/<programSlug>/<archetypeId>/<geoId>/<year>/<modelVersion>. Never reused for a different key.

orgId.description: Registry ID. Prefer us-ein:<9 digits, no dash> once the EIN is verified from IRS/ProPublica; otherwise slug:<org-name>. Never guess an EIN.

fiscalSponsorEin.description: When the program is fiscally sponsored, the EIN that actually receives gifts.

archetypeId.description: ID of an intervention template under templates/. Use 'bespoke' only when no template fits; bespoke records must explain why in scope.templateFitNote.

geoId.description: e.g. us-ca-san-francisco, us-il-chicago. Matches a parameters/<geoId>/ directory.

beneficiaryBasis.description: Whether the geography describes where beneficiaries live or only where services are delivered.

residenceShare.description: Optional share of modeled benefit going to residents of this geography.

year.description: Price year and service year of the modeled marginal gift.

tier.description: draft: CI-valid only. agent-reviewed: at least one independent adversarial agent audit passed with no unresolved blocking finding. human-reviewed: a named human reviewer without a conflict accepted it. retracted: kept for history; excluded from search and allocation.

supersedes.description: ID of the record this one replaces.

parameterSets.description: Local parameter files consumed, in precedence order (later overrides earlier).

overrides.description: Template parameters (universal or local) this record replaced, with a reason. Overriding a universal parameter blocks promotion past draft until an auditor accepts the reason.

counterfactual.description: What happens without the marginal gift.

inputs.description: Resolved values for every parameter the template formula needs, keyed by parameter name.

unit.description: Native outcome unit, e.g. 'additional opioid-overdose deaths averted', 'kg of sustained weight loss-year', 'participant completing a 24-week balance course'.

perUnitCost.description: What the cost denominator counts, e.g. 'naloxone dose distributed'.

centralPoint.description: Formula evaluated with every input at its p50. Differs from the simulated p50 because the formula is nonlinear.

boundary.description: Which costs are counted. unit-cost-judgment means an analyst allowance, not executed accounts.

qalyLayer.description: Optional. A versioned conversion from native outcomes to QALYs. Absent means no conversion is claimed. Readers can swap in a different bridge without changing the native estimate.

pricePer10Qalys.description: USD per 10 incremental QALYs. Null quantiles mean no finite price at that quantile (non-positive benefit).

centralPointPricePer10Qalys.description: Formula evaluated with every input at its p50. Differs from the simulated p50 because the formula is nonlinear.

basis.description: marginal: estimate for the next donated dollar. average: historical spending divided by historical outputs. average-adjusted-to-marginal: average with explicit retention/additionality discounts.

adjustments.description: Names of inputs that move average toward marginal, e.g. marginalYieldRetention, fundingAdditionality.

nullBoundary.description: Conditions under which benefit is zero or negative, so no finite price exists.

sessions.description: Closed, organization-specific research intervals, mirroring data/research-effort.json. Missing intervals stay missing; never apportion a batch duration.

model.description: Verified runtime AI model. Null when unverified; never inferred from UI settings or another worker.

human.description: Public handle of a human reviewer, if any.

evidence.description: Publishable artifact reference; no private logs or credentials.

independent.description: True only when the auditor did not author or model this record and had no access to the author's private reasoning beyond the record itself.

declared.description: True if any author, reviewer or the agent's principal has a financial, employment, board, grant or family relationship with the organization or a direct competitor for the same funds.

selfSubmitted.description: Organization (or its agent) authored this record about itself. Self-submitted records are capped at 'draft' until independently re-derived.

legacyModel.description: Repository path of the pre-template model this record was factored from.

distribution.description: Three quantiles. When basis is 'analyst-scenarios', p10/p90 are pessimistic/optimistic analyst scenarios, not calibrated quantiles; readers must not treat them as an 80% interval.

shape.description: How a simulator should interpolate between quantiles. fixed means p10=p50=p90 (a convention).

locator.description: Page, table or quoted figure supporting the value.

scope.description: universal: literature effect size reused across geographies. local: geography-specific (costs, baseline rates, population). org: specific to this organization's own reported data. convention: modeling choice such as a discount rate.

from.description: Template or parameter file path supplying this value, when inherited.

overrideReason.description: Required in practice when a parameter file or recipe replaces a template default; the evaluator copies it to template.overrides.

template.title: Open BOTEC intervention template
template.description: An intervention archetype: one formula, with every parameter labeled universal (literature, reused everywhere), local (geography-specific lookups), org (the organization's own reported data) or convention (modeling choices). Universal and convention values live here. Local and org values live in parameters/<geoId>/<archetypeId>.json or in an estimate recipe. Formulas use the restricted expression grammar in agents.md: numbers, parameter names, + - * / ^ ( ), and exp, log, min, max.

causeArea.description: Search facet, e.g. overdose, chronic-disease, healthy-aging, housing.

unit.description: What one unit of cost buys, e.g. 'naloxone dose distributed'.

costParameter.description: Name of the parameter (or derived quantity) holding USD per unit.

derived.description: Named intermediate expressions, evaluated in order, available to later expressions and formulas.

nativeOutcomesPerUnit.description: Native outcomes produced per unit of the cost denominator at the margin.

default.description: Required for universal and convention parameters. Local/org parameters must not carry a default, so a missing lookup fails loudly instead of silently inheriting San Francisco.

lookup.description: How a localizing agent finds this value in a new geography.

judgmentGuide.description: For judgment parameters: the anchors the SF author used, so another geography's judgment is comparable.

reproduces.description: What the template reproduces exactly from the legacy model and what it changes.

parameters.title: Open BOTEC local parameter file
parameters.description: Local (and, rarely, overriding universal) values for one archetype in one geography. Shared by every organization in that geography that uses the archetype. Org-specific values go in the estimate recipe instead.

templates.name: CDC-recognized lifestyle-change diabetes prevention program (National DPP) for adults with prediabetes
appliesWhen: The marginal gift funds additional enrolled adults in a year-long group lifestyle program following the CDC National DPP curriculum (YMCA, community health centers, health departments).
Participants are adults with prediabetes or high risk; not children.
doesNotApplyWhen: The program is a one-off nutrition class, food distribution, or diabetes self-management education for people who already have diabetes.
The gift funds a cohort an insurer (Medicare MDPP, Medicaid, employer plan) would otherwise pay for, unless fundingAdditionality reflects that.

nativeOutcome.notes: Weight loss relative to an offer-only control, summed over the years it persists. Diabetes cases averted would be a better native unit; v1 keeps the SF model's weight pathway.

qalyBridge.notes: Observational association of weight change with EQ-5D utility. Excludes diabetes-avoidance QALYs beyond what utility captures, so likely conservative for high-risk cohorts and generous for low-risk ones.
